reit.title: Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs)
reit.distribution_rule: At least 90% of Net Distributable Cash Flows (NDCF) must be distributed to unitholders at least semi-annually (most Indian REITs distribute quarterly).
reit.distribution_rule_source: SEBI (Real Estate Investment Trusts) Regulations, 2014, Reg 18(16)
reit.tax_dividend: Exempt if SPV opted for Section 115BAA concessional tax regime; otherwise taxed at investor's marginal income tax slab rate.
reit.tax_interest: Taxed at unitholder's applicable slab rate.
reit.tax_rental_income: Taxed at unitholder's applicable slab rate under Section 10(23FCA).
reit.tax_repayment_of_capital: Amounts exceeding issue price taxed as deemed income / under Section 56(2)(xii). Check current rules.
reit.tax_ltcg: 12.5% on aggregate capital gains exceeding ₹1,25,000 per financial year (holding period > 12 months, post Finance Act 2024).

invit.title: Infrastructure Investment Trusts (InvITs)
invit.distribution_rule: At least 90% of Net Distributable Cash Flows (NDCF) must be distributed to unitholders at least semi-annually (or quarterly).
invit.lot_size: 1 unit on NSE / BSE for public InvITs
invit.tax_dividend: Exempt if SPV opted for Section 115BAA; otherwise taxed at investor's marginal slab rate.
invit.tax_interest: Taxed at investor's marginal slab rate.
invit.tax_ltcg: 12.5% above ₹1.25 lakh (holding period > 12 months, post Finance Act 2024).

gsec.title: Government Securities (G-Secs)
gsec.min_investment_primary: ₹10,000 via RBI Retail Direct or exchange primary non-competitive bidding
gsec.min_investment_secondary: 1 bond (₹100 face value) on stock exchanges
gsec.credit_risk: Sovereign guarantee (lowest default risk in INR)
gsec.tax_interest: Added to total income and taxed at marginal income tax slab rate. No TDS deducted by RBI on central/state g-secs in primary accounts.
gsec.tax_capital_gains_ltcg: 12.5% without indexation if held for more than 12 months (post Finance Act 2024).
gsec.tax_capital_gains_stcg: Taxed at applicable marginal slab rate if held <= 12 months.

sources.name: Reserve Bank of India - Government Securities FAQ

tbill.title: Treasury Bills (T-Bills)
tbill.pricing_structure: Zero-coupon: issued at a discount to face value and redeemed at par (₹100).
tbill.min_investment: ₹10,000 and in multiples of ₹10,000 thereof via primary auctions / RBI Retail Direct
tbill.interest_frequency: No periodic interest coupon; difference between issue price and face value is the return
tbill.tax_return: Gain upon redemption is treated as short-term capital gain (or business income/other sources) and taxed at marginal slab rate.

sgb.title: Sovereign Gold Bonds (SGB)
sgb.coupon_rate: 2.50% per annum, payable semi-annually on nominal value
sgb.tenor: 8 years with early exit option from 5th year on coupon dates
sgb.capital_gains_exemption: Capital gains on maturity redemption by an individual are completely exempt from tax under Section 47(viic).
sgb.secondary_market_tax: If sold in secondary market before 8-year maturity: LTCG at 12.5% without indexation if held > 12 months; STCG at slab rate if held <= 12 months.
sgb.tax_coupon: 2.5% annual interest is taxed at investor's marginal slab rate.
sgb.new_issuance_status: Check current RBI issuance calendar. Government has not scheduled fresh tranches recently; existing tranches remain active on secondary exchange markets.

sources.name: RBI Sovereign Gold Bond Operational Guidelines

corpbond.title: Corporate Bonds & Debentures
corpbond.face_value_private_placement: ₹10,000 (reduced by SEBI from ₹1,00,000 in July 2024 to enhance retail participation)
corpbond.face_value_public_issue: Usually ₹1,000 per debenture in public issuances
corpbond.lot_size_source: SEBI Circular on reduction of face value of debt securities (July 2024)
corpbond.credit_rating_scale: AAA (highest safety), AA, A, BBB (investment grade), BB and below (speculative / high credit risk)
corpbond.tax_interest: Added to total income and taxed at marginal income tax slab rate. TDS of 10% under Section 193 applies to listed debentures (verify PAN submission).
corpbond.tax_capital_gains_ltcg: 12.5% without indexation if listed and held > 12 months (post Finance Act 2024).
corpbond.tax_capital_gains_stcg: Taxed at investor's slab rate if held <= 12 months.
